adjudication_question: Is D02/D14 differential expression robust at sample level and beyond a meaningful effect size?
required_evidence: edgeR QL, LOSO, annotation sensitivity and glmTreat

adjudication_question: Is this specific human orthologue confidently mapped, EC-expressed and accessible?
required_evidence: orthology, human donor RNA and canonical protein topology

adjudication_question: Is the native adult brain EC epitope exposed on the blood-facing membrane?
required_evidence: polarized endothelial protein/antibody or accessibility assay

adjudication_question: Does the selected ligand mediate productive internalization rather than degradation/recycling?
required_evidence: matched ligand format, receptor dependence and trafficking

adjudication_question: Is intact peptide/cargo shown beyond brain vasculature, with preserved barrier integrity?
required_evidence: quantitative abluminal or capillary-depleted parenchymal transport

adjudication_question: Could peripheral vessels, blood cells or soluble receptor bind the candidate?
required_evidence: HPA transcript context plus native protein and ligand binding

adjudication_question: Are receptor construct, membrane context, glycan/SS bridges and PDB/model quality suitable?
required_evidence: target-specific structural inspection and explicitly approved coordinates

adjudication_question: Which positive and negative ligand/cargo controls share the same transport assay and endpoint?
required_evidence: defined ligand-format controls, intact-peptide detection and barrier readout
